caption.noWorkers: No workers running. Start one to rent a GPU for your graphs.
caption.noProfiles: No profiles yet. Create one below.
caption.profileTemplate: A profile is a saved template. Provisioning it rents one GPU box and connects this app to it.

hint.ready: Worker is answering — safe to attach

confirm.terminate: Terminate this worker? Its volume and all cached models are permanently deleted. This stops all billing.

warning.orphan: {{count}} orphaned worker(s) may still be billing — stop them in your provider console
warning.apiKeyMissingDesc: Add it in Settings → Models & Providers before provisioning a {{provider}} worker — provisioning fails without it.

helper.name: A label to recognise this template, e.g. “A40 image worker”.
helper.provider: Where the GPU is rented. RunPod runs a dedicated pod; Vast picks the cheapest matching offer on its marketplace.
helper.gpuRunpod: Which machine to rent. Pick a GPU for model inference, or “CPU only” for a cheaper CPU pod (e.g. data/text nodes). More VRAM runs larger models.
helper.gpuVast: Which GPU to rent. More VRAM runs larger models; pick the smallest that fits to save money.
helper.gpuIdRunpod: Exact RunPod id, e.g. “NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation”.
helper.vcpu: Number of virtual CPUs for the CPU-only pod. RunPod picks a matching CPU flavor.
helper.disk: Persistent volume for the model cache. Models download here once and survive a stop/resume. HF models are large — keep this generous.
helper.idleTimeout: Idle this long → pause (GPU freed, volume + models kept). Your main guard against runaway GPU bills. Blank = never.
helper.workerImagePreset: ComfyUI worker fronts a co-located ComfyUI server for the “Run ComfyUI Workflow (Worker)” node.
helper.workerImage: Container image the provider runs. Pick a preset above, or set your own worker build.
helper.tokenPolicy: Generate issues a fresh auth token per worker (recommended). Fixed reuses a token you set elsewhere.
helper.maxLifetime: Hard cap: at this age the worker is TERMINATED — pod and volume destroyed (models lost) — to stop all billing. Blank = no cap.
